chars.UNCLE: UNCLE: a tall middle-aged man wearing a brown leather jacket over a mustard-yellow sweater, dark jeans and black shoes.
chars.BOY: BOY: a small 6-year-old boy (half the height of the adults) wearing a bright red puffy hooded winter coat, blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.MAN: MAN: a thin old man wearing a long black djellaba with a pointed hood up, a string of dark prayer beads around his neck.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a dim traditional Moroccan salon with low sedari benches and zellige tiles. The UNCLE firmly grips the frightened BOY's arm, holding him down on the bench, while the MAN leans in toward the boy holding a long thin metal needle and a small glass bottle. The boy pulls back in fear, tense confrontation.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot in the same dim Moroccan salon: the MAN collects a few drops of red blood from the BOY's small arm into a small glass bottle with a wide mouth. The BOY is crying with tears, the UNCLE holds the boy's shoulders and looks away nervously.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same dim Moroccan salon: the MAN presses a white cotton ball on the BOY's arm and makes the boy hold it with his other hand. The MAN stands up carrying the small glass bottle carefully. The UNCLE kneels next to the sniffling BOY.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same dim Moroccan salon: the UNCLE pulls the sleeve of the BOY's red coat down to hide a white bandage on the boy's arm, glancing toward the door suspiciously. The BOY watches him confused.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The UNCLE crouches in front of the BOY in a narrow alley of a new Moroccan neighborhood, holding one finger to his lips with a serious, threatening look, his other hand on the boy's shoulder. The BOY listens, wide-eyed and worried.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the same alley the BOY nods and smiles with relief, the UNCLE pats his head and smiles a fake, too-wide smile while hiding a small glass bottle in his jacket pocket behind his back.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Seen from outside through the side window: an old white car driving on a dusty rural road with empty fields near Casablanca. The UNCLE drives, the MAN sits in the front passenger seat, the small BOY sits alone in the back seat looking out the window at them.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside the car, view from the back seat: the MAN in the front passenger seat whispers to the UNCLE while holding up the small glass bottle of blood; the UNCLE grins. In the foreground the BOY in the back seat overhears them, shocked and terrified, eyes wide.
